notes.title: V1.25d version adjustment
notes.content:
1. Replay adds the option of skipping the plot.
2. When the critical strike and dodge reach the upper limit, they will no longer eat the attribute points.
3. Increase the number of start treasures, and increase the number of battles in each round.
4. Increase the amount of physical medication in stores.

notes.title: Happy New Year's Day, thank the connoisseur!
notes.content:
"Thousands of sails have passed by the side of the sunken boat, and ten thousand trees and springs lie ahead of the sick tree."
On the occasion of New Year's Day, I thank every connoisseur and player for their comments and suggestions on "Ao Huang Yi Jian Jie" (hereinafter referred to as "Ao Huang"). I have received many interesting amendments. I will adjust some contents as soon as possible in these two days. I also thank the foreigner who wants to help translate it into German or English. Thank you for your attention to the game.
The simplicity of play in Ao Huang is an unavoidable problem, which I also experienced during the test. This is due to the immaturity of my original design and the lack of design experience. Of course, I try to make up for it later, but the effect is not ideal.
The publication of "Ao Huang" has made me accumulate valuable experience. I believe that these experiences will guide me better in the future. Many things, if not to do and try in person, will not get real feelings and experience. Therefore, science pays attention to experiments, which reminds me of the story of the ancient Shu despicable monk in China.
In the updating of Ao Huang, the general method of play should be fixed, and numerical changes will be made to try to make the players feel better.
"Listen to your song today, with the spirit of a long glass of wine."

notes.title: A Letter to Players
notes.content:
Dear players, it's a great honor that "Ao Huang Yi Jian Tips" will soon log on to STEAM platform and meet you. As a developer, I am both excited and uneasy at the moment. The first stand-alone game I'm excited about will show up; I'm not sure if it will bring a satisfying experience to my players and friends.
It must feel like a bride to be married.
2018 is a very special year. My favorite writer, Mr. Jin Yong, died immortally. I would like to pay tribute to Mr. Jin Yong on behalf of this game.
My own game knows best. In the battle part, I learned from the model of "Jinyong Group Chivalrous Biography 2", and also saw that the battle model is from "Tianlong Babu", but I have not played "Tianlong Babu".
I have been obsessed with games since childhood. When I was a few years old, I liked to play Super Mario. At that time, I called it "mushroom picking". Later, I played the game in VCD. I liked "Three Kingdoms 3" most. Later, I remembered that it was my birthday. My uncle bought a CD-ROM "Three Kingdoms 7" from the stall for me. It was limited to the age at that time. I thought that the CD-ROM was just right. Edition, later I learned that has been under the honor of a genuine version, we all understand.
After college, I enjoyed playing the series of Jinyong swordsman biography very much. At the same time, I played a lot of games, thinking about the stories inside, thinking about it, and in my heart, I germinated to make a game of my own.
Now, this game has come out, although there is still a big gap with my ideal effect, but the journey of thousands of miles, started with the footsteps.
"Ao Huang Yi Jian Jie" is not a perfect game work, but I believe that in the future, I will strive to present more interesting and durable game works to the players, thank you!
Finally, I hope you can give me a good comment and encouragement while enjoying the "Ao Huang Yijian Tips".
Thank you again!
